Welcome! This issue tracks your first Git & GitHub contribution.

### Your Task

Create a profile file with your name and GitHub username so we can track participation.

### Getting Started

Follow the full step-by-step instructions in **[README.md](https://github.com/EndToEndLabCR/firstcommit-lab-github/blob/main/README.md)**.

In short:

1. Fork this repo & clone your fork
2. Create a branch: `feature/your-username`
3. Copy `PARTICIPANT-TEMPLATE.md` → `participants/yourusername.md` and fill in your info
4. Commit, push, and open a PR to this repo

### Review

A team member will review your PR. Address any feedback and push again — once approved, it'll be merged!

Reply to this issue if you get stuck.
